meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

copy.tagline: 通过 signal-cli 设备链接添加 Signal 频道集成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将 Signal 频道集成到你的应用中
copy.tagline_en: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Signal channels into your application

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，助手会通过Signal应用收发消息。先用手机扫码把助手绑到你的Signal号码上，之后你或别人发来的Signal消息都会转给助手，助手能直接回复；你也能通过“笔记给自己”给它发指令。
howto.when: 在把助手接入Signal时使用，比如在/setup流程中，或之后用/init-first-agent等命令接入频道。

say.note: 开始按步骤绑定你的Signal号码。

say.text: 用/init-first-agent把Signal连到一个智能体组。
say.note: 将Signal消息路由到指定智能体。

say.text: 给刚刚发消息的Signal用户授权。
say.note: 授权后该用户才能正常与助手对话。

howto.what_en: After installing, your assistant can send and receive Signal messages. Link it to your Signal number via QR scan; incoming messages are routed to it, and you can reach it via Note to Self.
howto.when_en: Used when connecting your assistant to Signal—e.g., during the /setup flow, or later when wiring via commands like /init-first-agent.

say_en.text: Add the Signal channel for me.
say_en.note: Starts the binding flow for your Signal number.

say_en.text: Use /init-first-agent to connect Signal to an agent group.
say_en.note: Routes Signal messages to your assistant.

say_en.text: Grant access to the Signal user who just messaged.
say_en.note: Lets that user talk to your assistant.
